name: clock-nudged-back
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with boluses from the pump's screen, on a pump whose clock had drifted 3 minutes ahead with no record of it. A 1.0 U bolus 35 minutes ago, then the user set the clock back 3 minutes on its screen 34 minutes ago (a TimeChanged record) and gave 0.8 U 33 minutes ago, which is stamped a minute before the bolus given two minutes earlier. Only the TimeChanged record puts the two in order. The pump's clock now matches the phone's.
